searchText: There is a difference in opinion on how <@552133098075193354> and <@388751025789468672> think estimateGas works in eip-1559. Who would have the final say? <@!206016661470314496>, what says you? 🙂 The Geth PR is what I remember from prior discussion. Perhaps <@552133098075193354> can shed some light on the source of info for that document. Though <@358385024573243393>, I'm not sure 0 is the same as missing? That Geth PR says missing. i'm also a big fan of creating new methods and using the `deprecated` field ethers, metamask, lots of other tooling doesnt just support ETH mainnet, so a timeframe for any of the tooling to actually deprecate things in practice in userland doesn't seem possible
